reader.zh-Hant: 此模組提供會話壓縮策略：歷史工具訊息 Level 0~3 壓縮、工具結果立即壓縮、以及 assistant 內容漸進式壓縮。
reader.en: This module provides conversation compression strategies: historical tool-message Level 0-3 compression, immediate tool-result compression, and progressive assistant-content compression.
reader.ja: このモジュールは会話圧縮戦略を提供します。履歴ツールメッセージの Level 0-3 圧縮、ツール結果の即時圧縮、assistant 内容の段階的圧縮に対応します。

types.name: SessionCompressionConfig
types.summary: Policy values controlling how aggressively old tool messages are compressed.

fields.name: keep_recent_tool_messages
fields.description: Most recent tool messages kept at full fidelity.

fields.name: enable_level3_collapse
fields.description: Whether to collapse older repeated tool traces into ActionLoop markers.

fields.name: immediate_tool_token_limit
fields.description: Base token threshold for immediate tool-result compression.

fields.name: immediate_tool_char_budget
fields.description: Character budget when compressing tool result.

fields.name: assistant_token_limit
fields.description: Base token threshold for assistant content compression.

fields.name: assistant_char_budget
fields.description: Character budget for assistant content compression.

fields.name: tool_line_collapse_trigger
fields.description: Line-count threshold to activate historical tool line collapsing.

fields.name: tool_line_collapse_head
fields.description: Head lines to keep when collapsing long tool output lines.

fields.name: tool_line_collapse_tail
fields.description: Tail lines to keep when collapsing long tool output lines.

fields.name: tool_line_collapse_max_chars
fields.description: Maximum character budget for collapsed tool preview content.

fields.name: compress_min_step
fields.description: No tool-output or history-tool compression until loop step exceeds this value (step > compress_min_step), unless a payload exceeds compress_min_chars.

fields.name: compress_min_chars
fields.description: If any tool message body is longer than this (characters), compression may run even when step is still low.

symbols.name: SessionToolResultCompressor
symbols.summary: Compress old role='tool' messages into metadata, trace markers, and semantic ActionLoop summaries.

methods.name: compress_messages
methods.signature: compress_messages(messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], *, loop_step: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Return a transformed message list where old tool entries are downgraded when the compress_min_step / compress_min_chars gate is passed; pass loop_step from AgentRuntime each turn.

methods.name: compress_tool_result_progressive
methods.signature: compress_tool_result_progressive(tool_name: str, content: str, step: int, max_steps: int) -> Dict[str, Any]
methods.summary: Compress tool result with stronger limits as step progresses.

methods.name: compress_assistant_content_progressive
methods.signature: compress_assistant_content_progressive(content: str, step: int, max_steps: int) -> Dict[str, Any]
methods.summary: Compress assistant text with progressively stronger limits over conversation steps.

runtime_notes.content: AGENT_TOOL_COMPRESS_MIN_STEP (default 4): compress only when runtime step is greater than this, or when a tool body exceeds AGENT_TOOL_COMPRESS_MIN_CHARS (default 40000). Same keys can be set via AgentRuntime compression_config: compress_min_step / compress_min_chars.
